approach: Extend the one existing decision gate, `decision_gate` (crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs:21). It already runs in the producer loop (`unreconciled_in_snapshot`, producer.rs:499) and at the candidate (`unreconciled_decisions`, mod.rs:1944). When `docs/decisions.md` is in the changed paths, it also calls a new pure `link_problems(base_links, cand_links, base_log, cand_log)` in athena-data. That function blames only what the change introduced, in three ways. (1) A [[link]] pair that no phrase of the candidate log names. (2) A phrase the change adds whose pair has no [[link]] (the producer's most likely mistake, finding 1). (3) A phrase that opens a statement but names no entry, on a line the base log lacks. A candidate list that no longer parses is a fourth finding. To make this possible without a cli dependency, move the phrase parse (`HitKind`, `Hit`, `Parsed`, `parse_supersessions` and helpers) from athena-cli backtest.rs into athena-data/decision_links.rs, and re-export it from backtest. There is then one parser for the loop check and for the backtest's condition (a). Key links on ids: drop `line` from `Link` (decisions.rs:47) and from the toml, match on (older, newer), and merge the duplicate pairs D46/D79 and D87/D88. A stray `line` key in an older base list is still ignored (neither `Link` nor `Pair` denies unknown fields). Reword the gate's unreconciled message to tell the producer to write `Amends <id>` or `Supersedes <id>` (finding 2). Add the advisory docs listing as pure `new_hits`, `citing_lines` and `citation_notes` in athena-data. Every superseded decision gets all its citing lines (capped at 40). An amended decision gets the first 5 plus a count (finding 4). The in-loop gate appends the lines to its failing message, so they reach the producer's one send-back. The candidate gate prints them as `decisions  note:` UI lines, so a passing change still shows them in the job log (finding 3). Record the change as D187 (`Amends D156`, plus a link D156 to D187), and update decision-sets.md §8 step 2 and the CHANGELOG. The D08 re-queue and the failure-class record are Athena actions outside this diff.

decisions.choice: A [[link]] resolves when a supersession phrase of the candidate log names its (older, newer) pair. The check is a delta against the base: it reports (1) a candidate link pair not named by the candidate log that is either new or was named by the base log; (2) a pair named by the candidate log but not the base log that has no candidate link; (3) a statement-opening phrase with no target id whose line text is not among the base's; (4) an unparsable candidate list. Each finding is worded under GATE_REASON_PREFIX and names the phrase or link to write.
decisions.reason: These are the same three halves as the backtest's condition (a): `unlisted`, `not_found` and `lacking_target` (backtest.rs:307-342), run at the final verdict. Findings (2) and (3) answer review finding 1: `Amends D02` with no link, or a phrase with no id, is caught in the loop and no longer at the verdict. The delta (candidate problems minus base problems) means a pre-existing break at the base cannot block every later job that edits decisions.md. The parse must live in athena-data because athena-core cannot depend on athena-cli (system facts, crate reach).

rejected.option: Report only the link-without-phrase direction (the previous plan)
rejected.why: A new phrase with no link, or with no target, passes the loop and fails the backtest test at the final verdict. The log is append-only and pinned (decisions.rs:200-204), so after id keying existing links cannot break; the only in-loop catches left are on new entries, and these are the likely mistakes.

rejected.option: Judge the whole candidate log and list against the full condition (a), with no base comparison
rejected.why: A repository whose base already has one unresolved link would fail every job that edits decisions.md, and the producer could not fix a fault it did not cause.

rejected.why: A link with no phrase would pass the loop and fail the backtest at the final verdict, which is the failure being removed.

rejected.why: A second parser would drift from the backtest's.

The pair is the only identity the check needs. An in-flight job's base list may still carry `line`, so it must still parse; `Pair` (decision_links.rs:69-73) and `Link` ignore unknown fields. The field is removed, not reused with a new meaning.

decisions.reason: The present text says an entry that `amends or supersedes each decision (or says it was checked and stands)` (checks.rs:46-49). Producers get one send-back (PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS, producer.rs:635), so a producer who follows it literally writes `Checked D08; stands` plus a link and is then refused by the new rule with no send-back left. Every existing checked-and-stands entry already says `Amends D08 in prose only` (decisions.md:4319, 4443, 4950), so the new wording matches practice.

rejected.option: Leave the message word for word, as the previous plan did

decisions.choice: The listing is advisory and never fails a job. It lists, for each `older` id of a phrase the change adds (`new_hits`), the docs/**/*.md lines outside docs/decisions.md that cite it as a whole token (`citing_lines`). A hit whose kind is Supersedes or SupersededBy lists every line (cap 40, then `and N more`). A hit whose kind is Amends lists the first 5 and a count. The candidate gate prints each line as a `decisions  note:` UI line. The in-loop gate appends the lines to its message only when it is already failing, so they reach the producer's one send-back. Nothing is shown in the loop when the gate passes.
decisions.reason: Reasons: (a) the listing is a heuristic on ids and cannot read meaning, so it must not fail a job; (b) the in-loop gate's string goes whole into the send-back brief (producer.rs:684-694, `send_back_text_full` gate parameter), so appending to it needs no producer.rs edit; (c) most new links are checked-and-stands amendments (docs/decision-links.toml:180-199), where every citing line is still true, so those are capped, while a superseded decision's lines are the ones most likely to be stale. The phrase kind, not the confirmed status, is used because the status lives in cli and moving it is not needed. D11 by D39 is a 'superseded by' phrase confirmed as amended, so for that rare case the listing is longer than needed, which is harmless. The in-loop gate is called with no UI (`unreconciled_in_snapshot(&self, base, snapshot, changes)`), and a producer-visible listing for a passing change needs a producer.rs edit that is out of scope.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs call `link_problems(base_links, cand_links, base_log, cand_log)` on in-test string constants. (a) A candidate list has a new link D02 to D99 and the log has no phrase naming it: one NotNamed. (b) The base log and list are the same, and the candidate log is the base log with 10 lines inserted before the first phrase, the list unchanged: no problem, so the log shifted by added lines passes. (c) A pair broken before the base (listed, never named at the base): not blamed. (d) A base pair named at the base whose phrase the candidate removes: NotNamed. (e) A candidate entry that says `Amends D02` with no link: NoLink. (f) A candidate entry with `Superseded by` and no id on a new line: NoTarget; the same line already present in the base log: not reported. (g) An unparsable candidate list: one finding.
demonstrations.observes: Each broken case returns the named finding with the pair or line text; the shifted-log, base-broken and clean cases return an empty list.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the check, (a), (e) and (f) return no finding and their assertions fail. Without id keying, (b) is not even expressible (a line-keyed pair would break on the shifted log). A delta that blamed the base would fail (c).
demonstrations.seam: `link_problems`, a pure function added in step 2. The fixtures are in-test string constants, so nothing is injected and no double stands in for the rule. The production caller is `decision_gate` (checks.rs:21). It also uses the moved `parse_supersessions` and the existing `link_pairs` (decision_links.rs:94).

demonstrations.method: New tests in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs use the existing `governed_repo`, `governed_job`, `editing`, `Counts` and `Lines` helpers (tests.rs:3168-3246), which run `Athena::go` with the fake agent `Script`. The base list is `GOVERNING_SRC` (governs only `src/`), so the producer's README edit is not governed. Case A: the producer edits the list to add a link D02 to D99 that no phrase names, and does not touch decisions.md: the job lands and the verifier ran once. Case B: the producer also appends a D13 entry with no phrase (`Checked D02; stands`) and a link D02 to D13: the job fails with a reason that starts with GATE_REASON_PREFIX and names D02 and D13, the producer ran twice (one send-back) and the verifier ran 0 times. Case C: the producer appends a D13 entry that says `Amends D02` and adds no link: the same hold, naming the missing [[link]]. Case D is the existing `governed_edit_with_an_amending_entry_and_link_reaches_the_verifier` (tests.rs:3790) with the fixed `reconciling_edits`: it lands.
demonstrations.observes: The job that does not touch decisions.md is not checked; jobs that touch it with a broken link, or a phrase with no link, close before the verifier with the prefix and (producer, verifier) = (2, 0); the clean one lands.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the check, case B and case C land with the verifier count 1 and the closing-reason assertion fails. Without the `changed` guard, case A closes with the prefix and fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry `Athena::go`, through the producer loop's `unreconciled_in_snapshot` (producer.rs:499) and the candidate gate (mod.rs:1944). The fake agent `Script` is built by the existing `editing` (tests.rs:3196), which adds `extra` edits to every producer pass; `governed_repo` seeds the log and list. All exist today. The only new pieces are the constant `GOVERNING_SRC` and the case texts, added in step 6.

demonstrations.method: athena-data tests call `citing_lines(&["D08"], docs)` and `citation_notes(hits, docs)` on in-test strings. Lines with `D08`, `D08's`, `(D08)`, `D08.` and `D08-` are listed; `D080`, `D8`, `AD08` and `D08x` are not; a hit in docs/decisions.md is skipped; a non-.md path is skipped. An Amends hit with 8 citing lines lists 5 plus a count line; a Supersedes hit with 8 lists all 8. Two core tests in tests.rs commit docs/guide.md (`D02 says the README is the entry point.`) into the governed repo. (1) `governed_edit_lists_docs_lines_citing_an_amended_decision_and_still_lands`: the producer reconciles with the fixed `reconciling_edits`; the job is Landed, the verifier ran once, and the UI has a line that starts `decisions  note: docs/guide.md:1`. (2) `governed_send_back_carries_the_docs_lines`: the producer appends an `Amends D02` entry with no link on every pass, so the gate fails; the second producer prompt (the send-back) contains `docs/guide.md:1` and says the lines are advisory; the closing reason does not contain `docs/guide.md`.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-data citing && cargo test --locked -p athena-core governed_edit_lists && cargo test --locked -p athena-core governed_send_back_carries
demonstrations.observes: The listing returns the docs lines that cite an amended or superseded decision id, outside decisions.md; it reaches a producer that is sent back and the job log of a passing job; it never changes a job's state.

A listing that failed the job would turn Landed into Failed and the first test's state assertion fails. A substring match would list D080 and fail the athena-data token test.

demonstrations.method: The producer appends D187 after D186 (decisions.md:5434) with Case, Decision (root cause: links keyed on log line numbers, and nothing resolved them before the final verdict), Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and a Provenance bullet. It holds the phrase `Amends D156` once and none of the words `supersedes`, `superseded by` or `amends` elsewhere. It adds the link D156 to D187 (amended) to the toml, rewrites decision-sets.md §8 step 2 (id keying, the in-loop check, the advisory rule) and adds a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry that names the root cause. A new test in decisions.rs asserts D187 exists, has a Provenance bullet and exactly one supersession phrase, and that CHANGELOG's Unreleased section names D187. The existing `the_decision_log_is_well_formed_and_only_appended_to` (decisions.rs:247) hashes the first PINNED_LEN = 359622 bytes and applies the mirror rule `decision_log_problems` (mirrors.rs:354).
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --lib decisions && cargo test --locked -p athena-core mirrors && git diff docs/decisions.md

The plan changes no reading-gate rule: the corpus runs `refusing_check` (refusal_corpus.rs:1-2), and none of the planned rules (pair resolution, whole-token id match, phrase parse) is a reading, plan or request check, so no corpus case maps to them. Their input forms, `D08`, `D08's`, `(D08)`, `D08.`, `D080`, `D8`, `AD08`, `D08x`, a path in docs/decisions.md, a non-.md path and the amended or superseded phrase kinds, each have a case in the new athena-data unit tests (criteria 1 and 5).
